scenes.title: Orbital Measurements
scenes.environment_intent: An expansive open canvas representing planetary orbit, focusing on precise geometric vectors, distances, and future trajectories over a minimalist Earth curvature.

beats.full_sentence: A satellite circles Earth at incredible speed.

visual_sub_beats.visual_action: A dark slate arc representing the Earth's surface anchors the bottom of the frame. Above it, a dashed circular orbital track is established, with a simplified geometric satellite positioned on the track.
The satellite accelerates, sweeping rapidly along the dashed orbital track from left to right.

beats.full_sentence: Its onboard instruments continuously measure its position and velocity.

visual_sub_beats.visual_action: Thin, faint structural lines project outward from the moving satellite, forming a localized crosshair coordinate frame centered on the craft.

A muted teal vector arrow extends outward from the implied center of the Earth directly to the satellite. A small, dynamic text label locks to the center of this vector, updating as the satellite moves.
A coral-colored vector arrow extends forward tangentially from the satellite's center along the flight path, accompanied by a changing numerical velocity label.

beats.full_sentence: These measurements help mission controllers understand its orbit and predict where it will travel next.

visual_sub_beats.narration_anchor: These measurements help mission controllers understand its orbit
visual_sub_beats.visual_action: The camera perspective slightly widens. The position vector, velocity vector, and the established dashed orbital track briefly pulse with a warm amber accent, visually linking the measurements to the orbit's geometric shape.

visual_sub_beats.narration_anchor: and predict where it will travel next.
visual_sub_beats.visual_action: A solid, soft cobalt line extends forward from the tip of the velocity vector, drawing out a smooth, extended arc along the future path of the orbit ahead of the moving satellite.
